def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0])
    # find separator column(s): all same value, nonzero, and value not equal to dominant values 0/3
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w)
                if len(set(grid[r][c] for r in range(h))) == 1
                and grid[0][c] not in (0, 3)]
    # fallback: any constant nonzero column
    if not sep_cols:
        sep_cols = [c for c in range(w)
                    if len(set(grid[r][c] for r in range(h))) == 1
                    and grid[0][c] != 0]
    c0 = sep_cols[0]
    left = [row[:c0] for row in grid]
    right = [row[c0+1:] for row in grid]
    n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        row = []
        for c in range(n):
            row.append(2 if left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0 else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
